standard_prerequisites.name: Pseudo-coherence chain
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows the twisted pullback is pseudo-coherent with coherent cohomology.

standard_prerequisites.name: Direct image coherence
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces boundedness of the FM image to boundedness of the tensor product.

standard_prerequisites.name: Tor amplitude tools
standard_prerequisites.use: Cases (3) and (4) verify finite tor dimension stalkwise.

core_obligations: Set up: the FM image equals the pushforward of the derived tensor product; pseudo-coherence gives coherent cohomology, supports are proper over Y, so only boundedness is at stake.
Case (1): variant derived pullback identifies the tensor product over the inverse image sheaf; tor dimension of K plus boundedness of M gives the bound.

Case (2): the flat bounded presentation implies finite tor dimension, reducing to case (1). Case (3): regularity of X gives finite projective dimension stalkwise, hence bounded tor amplitude. Case (4): flatness of R -> B makes the perfect tensor product finite tor dimension.
proof_roadmap: Prove the pseudo-coherence setup once, then run the four cases; each case names its engine and verifies hypotheses.
difficulty_reason: Four hypotheses each argued with named permanence lemmas; case (1) carries the tor-dimension engine, (2)-(4) reduce with real verifications.
